lessons.text: Never use appeal to popularity (Everyone believes it, therefore it is true). It cost you against Socrates.

Prepare an answer before you assert: Socrates broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. Because remote work protects deep focus, the documented cases show the be…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Your winning pattern: "However, your premise assumes what it needs to prove, and the data shows otherwise. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the pre…" — it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.
